question: A is the son of C, but C is not the mother of A. B is A’s sister. C and D are a married couple. E is the mother of C. Who is A’s mother?
solution:
Family chart :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/749b5b689090c8a303af7be8d3e16c0fd60e1068fd8dc460dddfc628895fff49.png] 

Family Tree :

1) A is the son of C, but C is not the mother of A and B is A’s sister.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85b5ee368543e9930d460f4d203e32f52d1744a464ba40a82d26daf29a4d6a80.png] 

2) C and D are a married couple and E is the mother of C. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0110b0e0281b2aa1676413bb242eccdf37a0cf101a0a1392aad52cef86a93682.png] 

∴ Here, 'D' is mother of 'A'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"D".**
